title: Signal: Python install pulls from an additional index
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution.
limitations: It matches an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
